about: What the Python service (uvicorn, default settings) and its upload parser did with the requests of test/http/multipart-cases.ts (research.md 16.9 (a)), recorded 2026-11-09 before the Python service is removed.

http: status and ErrorResponse code of the first answer to the raw request (code null: no JSON code). parser: receive_upload steps on the body alone, in one chunk (accepted, file name, mimeType hint, file size and sha1).
parserWithoutCharset: the same with the charset parameter removed from the Content-Type: the Node service does not read the request charset (research.md 7.5 3), so this is its expectation.
requestSha1: sha1 of rawRequest(case, REQUEST_TOKEN); a mismatch means the generator no longer builds the bytes these results belong to.
